summary: Completed testing of Supply form new fields feature for DynSoft Pharma. All 10 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests verified all new fields (Périme le, N° Lot, Rayon, TVA %) and info panel (Stock actuel, Catégorie, Coef. intérêt, Prix de vente). Fixed a critical bug where 'categories' was undefined in Supplies.js.

backend: GET /api/supplies returns items with current_stock, markup_coefficient, selling_price, category_name
selling_price is calculated as unit_price * markup_coefficient
POST /api/supplies accepts items with lot_number, shelf_location, tva_rate, date_peremption
POST /api/supplies works without optional new fields (defaults applied)
PUT /api/supplies/{id} can update items with new fields
Supply validation creates stock_lots with lot_number, shelf_location, tva_rate
GET /api/supplies/{id} returns items with enriched fields
shelf_location field accepts string values with special characters
frontend: Info panel shows 'Stock actuel' when product selected
Info panel shows 'Catégorie' when product selected
Info panel shows 'Coef. intérêt' when product selected
Info panel shows 'Prix de vente' (calculated) when product selected
Items table displays P. Vente column
Items table displays N° Lot column
Product can be added with all new fields filled

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Supplies.js was missing 'categories' state and loadCategories function - added useState and useCallback to fetch categories from /api/categories
SupplyItem model correctly includes new fields: lot_number, shelf_location, tva_rate, date_peremption
Backend enrich_supply function correctly calculates selling_price = unit_price * markup_coefficient
Backend create_stock_lot_from_supply correctly passes lot_number, shelf_location, tva_rate to stock_lots
Frontend info panel correctly displays calculated fields when product is selected
Items table correctly displays all new columns with proper formatting
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/pages/Supplies.js - Added categories state and loadCategories function to fix ReferenceError
/app/tests/test_supply_new_fields.py - Created comprehensive test suite for supply new fields feature
